lead.text: Streetlights hum on an empty street
I count the cracks beneath my feet
Your coat is gone but the hallway smells like rain
I keep the porch light on again
I keep the porch light on again
Maybe the night is a door left open
Maybe the dark is kinder than it seems
Paper lanterns in the rain
Burning slow and going out again
Hold the light a little longer
Let the quiet pull me under
Morning comes with a quiet ache
I fold the sheets that we never made
The radio plays what it always plays
And I sing along a beat too late
And I sing along a beat too late
Maybe the night is a door left open
Maybe the dark is kinder than it seems
Paper lanterns in the rain
Burning slow and going out again
Hold the light a little longer
Let the quiet pull me under
Call it a season, call it a ghost
I'm learning how to miss you most
Call it a season, call it a ghost
Paper lanterns in the rain
Burning slow and going out again
Hold the light a little longer
Let the quiet pull me under
Paper lanterns in the rain
